description_en: Mounts a table to a specified business category to correct incorrect category mounting. If Replace is set to true, the table is unmounted from other existing categories first
description_zh: 手动把表挂载到指定业务目录，用于修正错误的目录挂载；Replace=true 时先解绑该表其它已有目录关系（改挂）
name: MountTableToCategory

parameters.help_en: The database ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html operation to obtain the database ID
parameters.name: db_id

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can obtain the tenant ID by moving the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target leaf category. This parameter and CategoryPath are mutually exclusive, and CategoryId takes precedence. You can call the ListAssetCategories operation to query the ID. If neither CategoryId nor CategoryPath is specified, the table is only unmounted from its existing categories
parameters.help_zh: 目标叶子目录 ID，与 CategoryPath 二选一（优先生效），可通过 ListAssetCategories 查询；与 CategoryPath 都不传时仅解绑该表现有目录
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en: The path of the target category. Separate levels with forward slashes (/). The system locates existing categories level by level, up to four levels deep. The final category must be a leaf category
parameters.help_zh: 目标目录路径（层级用 / 分隔），逐层定位已有目录，最深 4 层；最终目录必须是叶子目录
parameters.name: category_path

parameters.help_en: The ID of the starting parent category for CategoryPath. If you leave this parameter empty, the search starts from the root category
parameters.help_zh: CategoryPath 的起始父目录 ID，留空表示从根目录开始
parameters.name: parent_category_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to create the categories in the CategoryPath level by level if they do not exist. Default value: false. If this parameter is set to false and the categories do not exist, a 404 error is returned to prevent accidental creation of categories due to incorrect paths
parameters.help_zh: CategoryPath 对应目录不存在时是否逐层创建，默认 false 直接报 404，避免误传路径凭空造目录
parameters.name: create_missing_category

CategoryId.description_en: The ID of the category to which the table is finally mounted. This parameter is empty if the table is only unmounted and no category parameters are specified
CategoryId.description_zh: 最终挂载到的目录 ID；纯解绑（不传目录参数）时为空
CategoryId.title_en: 最终挂载到的目录 ID；纯解绑（不传目录参数）时为空
CategoryId.title_zh: 最终挂载到的目录 ID；纯解绑（不传目录参数）时为空

NewlyMounted.description_en: Indicates whether a new mount relationship is created. A value of false indicates that the relationship between the table and the target category already exists
NewlyMounted.description_zh: 是否新建了挂载关系，false 表示表与目标目录的关系已存在
NewlyMounted.title_en: 是否新建了挂载关系，false 表示表与目标目录的关系已存在
NewlyMounted.title_zh: 是否新建了挂载关系，false 表示表与目标目录的关系已存在

RemovedCategoryIds.description_en: The IDs of the original categories from which the table is unmounted in this request. Under single-mount semantics, mounting the table to a new category automatically unmounts it from the old categories
RemovedCategoryIds.description_zh: 本次被解绑的原目录 ID 列表（单挂载语义下挂新目录会自动解绑旧目录）

items.description_en: The ID of an original category from which the table is unmounted in this request
items.description_zh: 本次被解绑的原目录 ID

RemovedCategoryIds.title_en: 本次被解绑的原目录 ID 列表（单挂载语义下挂新目录会自动解绑旧目录）
RemovedCategoryIds.title_zh: 本次被解绑的原目录 ID 列表（单挂载语义下挂新目录会自动解绑旧目录）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
